title: REGULATIONS ON PUBLIC HOLIDAYS OF GOVERNMENT OFFICES
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters regarding public holidays of government offices pursuant to the State Public Officials Act and the Act on Public Holidays. <Amended on Aug. 4, 2021>

Article 2 (Public holidays) Public holidays of government offices shall be as follows; provided, public holidays of diplomatic missions abroad shall consist of national holidays under the Act on National Holidays and public holidays of the host country: <Amended on Dec. 18, 1998; Jun. 30, 2005; Sep. 6, 2006; Dec. 28, 2012; Oct. 17, 2017; Apr. 30, 2026>
  1. Sundays;
  2. National holidays under the Act on National Holidays;
  3. January 1;
  4. The day preceding Seollal (Korean New Year's Day), Seollal, and the day following Seollal (the last day of the 12th lunar month, and the 1st and 2nd days of the 1st lunar month);
  5. Buddha’s Birthday (the 8th day of the 4th lunar month);
  6. Labor Day (May 1);
  7. Children's Day (May 5);
  8. Memorial Day (June 6);
  9. The day preceding Chuseok (Korean Thanksgiving Day), Chuseok, and the day following Chuseok (the 14th, 15th, and 16th days of the 8th lunar month);
  10. Christmas Day (December 25);
  10-2. Election days for elections held on the termination of term of office referred to in Article 34 of the Public Official Election Act;
  11. Other days designated by the Government from time to time.

Article 3 (Substitute public holidays) (1) Where a public holiday specified in any of subparagraphs 2 through 10 of Article 2 falls under any of the following cases, the first non-public holiday following such public holiday (referring to a day other than the public holidays under the subparagraphs of Article 2; hereinafter the same shall apply) shall be designated as a substitute public holiday: <Amended on May 4, 2023; Apr. 30, 2026>
  1. Where any public holiday under subparagraph 2,subparagraphs 5 through 7, or subparagraph 10 of Article 10 falls on a Saturday or Sunday;
  2. Where any public holiday under subparagraph 4 or 9 of Article 2 falls on a Sunday;
  3. Where any public holiday under subparagraph 2,subparagraphs 4 through 7,subparagraph 9, or 10 of Article 2 falls on a day other than Saturday or Sunday and overlaps with another public holiday under subparagraphs 2 through 10 of that Article.
  (2) Where the alternative public holiday under paragraph (1) overlaps on the same day, the substitute public holidays shall last until the first non-public holiday following such substitute public holiday.
  (3) Where the alternative public holiday under paragraphs (1) and (2) falls on a Saturday, the first non-public holiday thereafter shall be a substitute public holiday.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Aug. 4, 2021]

Article 4 (Designation of temporary public holidays) Designation of public holidays under subparagraph 11 of Article 2 shall be deliberated upon by the State Council.
  [This Article Added on Aug. 4, 2021]
